sql: SELECT 'wholesale' part,COUNT(*) n,MIN(whsle_date) lo,MAX(whsle_date) hi,COUNT(DISTINCT item_code) items FROM veg_whsle_df UNION ALL SELECT 'transactions',COUNT(*),MIN(txn_date),MAX(txn_date),COUNT(DISTINCT item_code) FROM veg_txn_df UNION ALL SELECT 'categories',COUNT(*),MIN(category_name),MAX(category_name),COUNT(DISTINCT item_code) FROM veg_cat UNION ALL SELECT 'loss',COUNT(*),MIN("loss_rate_%"),MAX("loss_rate_%"),COUNT(DISTINCT item_code) FROM veg_loss_rate_df

SELECT [sale/return] kind,COUNT(*) n,MIN([qty_sold(kg)]) min_qty,MAX([qty_sold(kg)]) max_qty,MIN([discount(%)]) min_discount,MAX([discount(%)]) max_discount FROM veg_txn_df GROUP BY [sale/return] UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_wholesale_keys',COUNT(*),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM (SELECT item_code,whsle_date FROM veg_whsle_df GROUP BY item_code,whsle_date HAVING COUNT(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'unmatched_transactions',COUNT(*),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM veg_txn_df t LEFT JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code=w.item_code AND t.txn_date=w.whsle_date WHERE w.item_code IS NULL

WITH wstats AS (SELECT substr(w.whsle_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,c.category_name,AVG(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) avg_wholesale_price,MAX(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) max_wholesale_price,MIN(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) min_wholesale_price FROM veg_whsle_df w JOIN veg_cat c USING(item_code) WHERE w.whsle_date>='2020-01-01' AND w.whsle_date<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY year,c.category_code,c.category_name), itemyear AS (SELECT DISTINCT substr(whsle_date,1,4) year,item_code FROM veg_whsle_df WHERE whsle_date>='2020-01-01' AND whsle_date<'2024-01-01'), rates AS (SELECT i.year,c.category_code,AVG(l.[loss_rate_%]) avg_loss_rate FROM itemyear i JOIN veg_cat c USING(item_code) JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l USING(item_code) GROUP BY i.year,c.category_code), financial AS (SELECT substr(t.txn_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) total_wholesale_price,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]) total_selling_price,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]*l.[loss_rate_%]/(100.0-l.[loss_rate_%])) total_loss FROM veg_txn_df t JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code=w.item_code AND t.txn_date=w.whsle_date JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code=c.item_code JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code=l.item_code WHERE t.txn_date>='2020-01-01' AND t.txn_date<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY year,c.category_code) SELECT * FROM financial ORDER BY year,category_code LIMIT 6

WITH wstats AS (SELECT substr(w.whsle_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,c.category_name,AVG(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) avg_wholesale_price,MAX(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) max_wholesale_price,MIN(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) min_wholesale_price FROM veg_whsle_df w JOIN veg_cat c USING(item_code) WHERE w.whsle_date>='2020-01-01' AND w.whsle_date<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY year,c.category_code,c.category_name), itemyear AS (SELECT DISTINCT substr(whsle_date,1,4) year,item_code FROM veg_whsle_df WHERE whsle_date>='2020-01-01' AND whsle_date<'2024-01-01'), rates AS (SELECT i.year,c.category_code,AVG(l.[loss_rate_%]) avg_loss_rate FROM itemyear i JOIN veg_cat c USING(item_code) JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l USING(item_code) GROUP BY i.year,c.category_code), financial AS (SELECT substr(t.txn_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) total_wholesale_price,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]) total_selling_price,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]*l.[loss_rate_%]/(100.0-l.[loss_rate_%])) total_loss FROM veg_txn_df t JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code=w.item_code AND t.txn_date=w.whsle_date JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code=c.item_code JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code=l.item_code WHERE t.txn_date>='2020-01-01' AND t.txn_date<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY year,c.category_code) SELECT w.year,w.category_name,ROUND(avg_wholesale_price,2) avg_wholesale_price,ROUND(max_wholesale_price,2) max_wholesale_price,ROUND(min_wholesale_price,2) min_wholesale_price,ROUND(max_wholesale_price-min_wholesale_price,2) wholesale_price_difference,ROUND(total_wholesale_price,2) total_wholesale_price,ROUND(total_selling_price,2) total_selling_price,ROUND(avg_loss_rate,2) avg_loss_rate,ROUND(total_loss,2) total_loss,ROUND(total_selling_price-total_wholesale_price-total_loss,2) profit FROM wstats w JOIN rates r USING(year,category_code) JOIN financial f USING(year,category_code) ORDER BY w.year,w.category_name

WITH joined AS (SELECT substr(t.txn_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,c.category_name,t.[sale/return] kind,t.[qty_sold(kg)] q,t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg] sp,w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg] wp,l.[loss_rate_%] rate FROM veg_txn_df t JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code=w.item_code AND t.txn_date=w.whsle_date JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code=c.item_code JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code=l.item_code), modes AS (SELECT 'net_all' mode UNION ALL SELECT 'sale_only'), j AS (SELECT mode,joined.* FROM joined CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode='net_all' OR kind='sale') SELECT mode,year,category_code,category_name,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(AVG(wp),2) avg_wp,ROUND(MAX(wp),2) max_wp,ROUND(MIN(wp),2) min_wp,ROUND(MAX(wp)-MIN(wp),2) diff_wp,ROUND(SUM(q*wp),2) cost,ROUND(SUM(q*sp),2) revenue,ROUND(AVG(rate),2) avg_rate,ROUND(SUM(q*wp)*AVG(rate)/100.0,2) loss_product_averages,ROUND(SUM(q*wp*rate/100.0),2) loss_rowwise,ROUND(SUM(q*sp)-SUM(q*wp)-SUM(q*wp)*AVG(rate)/100.0,2) profit_product,ROUND(SUM(q*sp)-SUM(q*wp)-SUM(q*wp*rate/100.0),2) profit_rowwise FROM j GROUP BY mode,year,category_code,category_name ORDER BY mode,year,category_code

WITH w AS (
  SELECT item_code, date(whsle_date) AS d, AVG(`whsle_px_rmb-kg`) AS px
  FROM veg_whsle_df GROUP BY 1,2
),
tday AS (
  SELECT item_code, date(txn_date) AS d,
         SUM(`qty_sold(kg)`) AS qty,
         SUM(`qty_sold(kg)`*`unit_selling_px_rmb/kg`) AS rev
  FROM veg_txn_df GROUP BY 1,2
),
joined AS (
  SELECT c.category_name AS category_name, strftime('%Y', tday.d) AS year,
         tday.qty AS qty, tday.rev AS rev, w.px AS px, l.`loss_rate_%` AS lr
  FROM tday
  JOIN veg_cat c ON c.item_code = tday.item_code
  JOIN w ON w.item_code=tday.item_code AND w.d=tday.d
  JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON l.item_code=tday.item_code
),
mon AS (
  SELECT category_name, year, SUM(qty*px) AS tot_cost, SUM(rev) AS tot_rev, SUM(qty*px*lr/100.0) AS tot_loss
  FROM joined GROUP BY 1,2
),
wh AS (
  SELECT c.category_name AS category_name, strftime('%Y', x.whsle_date) AS year,
         AVG(x.`whsle_px_rmb-kg`) AS avg_px, MAX(x.`whsle_px_rmb-kg`) AS max_px, MIN(x.`whsle_px_rmb-kg`) AS min_px
  FROM veg_whsle_df x JOIN veg_cat c ON c.item_code=x.item_code GROUP BY 1,2
),
lrc AS (
  SELECT c.category_name AS category_name, AVG(l.`loss_rate_%`) AS avg_lr
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df l JOIN veg_cat c ON c.item_code=l.item_code GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.category_name AS category_name, m.year AS year,
  ROUND(wh.avg_px,2) AS average_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(wh.max_px,2) AS maximum_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(wh.min_px,2) AS minimum_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(wh.max_px-wh.min_px,2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
  ROUND(m.tot_cost,2) AS total_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(m.tot_rev,2) AS total_selling_price,
  ROUND(lrc.avg_lr,2) AS average_loss_rate,
  ROUND(m.tot_loss,2) AS total_loss,
  ROUND(m.tot_rev - m.tot_cost,2) AS profit
FROM mon m JOIN wh ON wh.category_name=m.category_name AND wh.year=m.year
JOIN lrc ON lrc.category_name=m.category_name
ORDER BY m.category_name, m.year;

WITH agg AS (SELECT substr(t.txn_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,c.category_name,ROUND(AVG(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) avg_wp,ROUND(MAX(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) max_wp,ROUND(MIN(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) min_wp,ROUND(MAX(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg])-MIN(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) diff_wp,ROUND(SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) cost,ROUND(SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]),2) revenue_float,ROUND(SUM(CAST(ROUND(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000) AS INTEGER)*CAST(ROUND(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100) AS INTEGER))/100000.0,2) revenue_exact,ROUND(AVG(l.[loss_rate_%]),2) avg_rate FROM veg_txn_df t JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code=w.item_code AND t.txn_date=w.whsle_date JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code=c.item_code JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code=l.item_code WHERE t.[sale/return]='sale' GROUP BY year,c.category_code,c.category_name) SELECT *,ROUND(cost*avg_rate/100.0,2) loss,ROUND(revenue_exact-cost-ROUND(cost*avg_rate/100.0,2),2) profit FROM agg ORDER BY year,category_code

SELECT substr(t.txn_date,1,4) year,c.category_name,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]) raw_revenue,SUM(CAST(ROUND(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000) AS INTEGER)*CAST(ROUND(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100) AS INTEGER)) scaled_integer_revenue,(SUM(CAST(ROUND(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000) AS INTEGER)*CAST(ROUND(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100) AS INTEGER))+500)/1000/100.0 integer_half_up_revenue,SUM(ABS(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000-ROUND(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000))>0.00001) qty_precision_violations,SUM(ABS(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100-ROUND(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100))>0.00001) px_precision_violations FROM veg_txn_df t JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code=c.item_code WHERE t.[sale/return]='sale' GROUP BY year,c.category_name
